repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true))
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait followed by actions. The candidate polls the sensor at the start of the cycle (t=0) inside an `if`, which misses the transition that occurs at t=100ms (F1, F2). The candidate must block on the rising edge using the two-wait rearm pattern (Example A) to observe the state change immediately.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a rising-edge state machine: block until false, clear state, block until true, then execute body. This ensures the action fires exactly when motion becomes true, matching the IR's rising edge semantics.
